# Test fixture: the `claude-plugin` layout

A small, synthetic collection in the layout of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`), read on 2026-09-23. Every
skill and rule here was written for the tests of `import --from skills` and
`export --to skills`; none is copied from a real collection. The fixture
text is CC0-1.0 unless a file in it states a licence of its own — those statements
are part of what the tests read.

No licence file sits at this fixture's root on purpose: one skill has no licence at all.
